verdict.rationale: Gusto's own pages say it guides founders through registering for a federal EIN as part of a single formation flow, but they also say these capabilities are in early beta and will reach more entrepreneurs over the coming months, so not every founder can use it yet. missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, detail on whether Gusto files the EIN application or only guides the owner, independent or hands-on corroboration of EIN issuance.
